entities.name: Abomination of Llanowar
entities.description: An elf horror formed by living and dead elves terrorizing Llanowar.

events.summary: A recruit touched the necromantic tangle, which imploded and fused the scouts into an undead monstrosity.
events.quote: A curious recruit touched the dark tangle, and it imploded

events.summary: The second scout troop was pulled alive into the monstrosity; one elf escaped.
events.quote: A single elf escaped, and that part of the forest was declared forbidden
